detail.longDescription: With every technological revolution, professions have evolved and the job market has reshaped itself without shrinking. The goal is to leverage technology to generate greater wealth, while managing the transition by funding training and retraining programs for those whose jobs are affected by AI. It would be a mistake to simply provide compensation for the loss of wealth. # ArtificialIntelligence # AI # LLM # LLMs # noai # MachineLearning # DeepLearning # research # tech # TransfoNum # technology
